prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling school science fair. On the left, a boy in a blue cap stands next to a girl with pigtails. The boy holds a magnifying glass over a small green plant. The girl points at the leaves while looking at him. In the center, a teacher in a gray suit sits on a folding chair. She is looking at a notebook resting on her lap. Next to her, a brown dog lies on the floor, chewing a bone. To the right of the dog, a volcano model erupts with fake foam. A man in a red scarf stands behind the volcano, pointing at the foam. He is talking to a woman in a yellow dress who is holding a clipboard. Behind them, a large poster board displays colorful charts. A robot with silver arms stands on a table near the poster. It has one arm raised in a wave. A cat with black fur sits on the table next to the robot, watching the crowd. In the background, a janitor in a blue uniform sweeps the floor. He is looking down at his broom. Near the entrance, a security guard in a black vest checks a list. He stands next to a stack of cardboard boxes. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no digital screen visible anywhere.
